label: Activate instance triggers
description: Turn on one instance's own triggers (the ones that exist once per instance). A trigger reading the instance's infra copy needs that copy running first. Triggers already on stay as they are.

inputs.name: instance
inputs.description: The instance, by the id your program gives it (`user-42`).

inputs.name: only
inputs.description: Only these triggers, named the way the program writes them. Every per-instance trigger when not wired.

outputs.name: done
outputs.description: True once the triggers are on. Wire it into the `_should_flow` of what must happen after.

then.message: ActivateInstanceTriggers '{id}' names {names} in `only`, which is no per-instance trigger of this program. Name each the way the program writes it (`inbox`, or `one.inbox` inside an included file).
